multimail-special-emailaddresses-summary: Boggan wuxuu liis gareeyaa cinwaannada iimaylka ee ku xidhan akoonkan. Farriimaha waxaad ku heli doontaa cinwaankaaga iimaylka aasaasiga ah. Waxaad boggan gaarka ah u adeegsan kartaa inaad beddesho cinwaankaaga iimaylka aasaasiga ah adigoon u baahnayn inaad mar kale xaqiijiso, taas oo kuu oggolaanaysa inaad dib u hesho gelitaanka akoonka haddii aad lumisay gelitaanka cinwaankaaga iimaylka aasaasiga ah.

tooltip-multimail-emails-pager-make-prim: Ka dhig cinwaankan iimaylka aasaasiga ah
multimail-special-add-email-view-summary: Foomkan wuxuu diiwaangelin doonaa cinwaan iimayl oo labaad oo cusub.
multimail-special-add-email-view-with-co: Foomkan wuxuu diiwaangelin doonaa cinwaan iimayl oo labaad oo cusub. Iimayl xaqiijin ah ayaa loo diri doonaa cinwaankan iimaylka.
multimail-invalid-email: Kani ma aha cinwaan iimayl oo sax ah.
multimail-special-add-email-view-confirm: Koodhka xaqiijinta ayaa loo diray cinwaankaaga iimaylka.
multimail-special-change-primary-view-co: Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad cinwaankaaga iimaylka aasaasiga ah ka beddesho $1 una beddesho $2?
multimail-emails-confirm-broken-token:
Koodhka xaqiijinta ama aqoonsiga isticmaalaha ma saxna.
Hubi iimaylkaaga, xidhiidhka xaqiijintu waxa laga yaabaa inuu iimaylkaaga si khaldan ugu go'ay.
multimail-emails-confirm-invalid:
Koodhka xaqiijintu ma saxna.
Koodhku waxa laga yaabaa inuu dhacay.
multimail-emails-confirm-success: Cinwaankaaga iimaylka hadda waa la xaqiijiyay.
multimail-special-delete-view-confirmati: Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad tirtirto cinwaanka iimaylka $1?
multimail-special-request-confirmation-c: Koodh xaqiijin cusub ayaa loo diray cinwaankaaga iimaylka.

Koodh xaqiijin ayaa horeba iimayl ahaan laguugu soo diray;
haddii aad dhawaan ku dartay cinwaankan iimaylka, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad sugto dhowr daqiiqo inta uu soo gaarayo ka hor intaadan isku dayin inaad codsato koodh cusub.
multimail-needlogin: Waa inaad gashan tahay akoonka si aad boggan si toos ah u gasho.
multimail-no-primary-email: Cinwaan iimayl oo aasaasi ah ayaa loo baahan yahay
multimail-no-primary-body: Cinwaan iimayl oo aasaasi ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo isticmaalo boggan gaarka ah. Waxaad ku dejin kartaa [[Special:Preferences#mw-prefsection-personal-email|dooqyadaada]].
multimail-email-disabled-body: MultiMail wuxuu u baahan yahay in shaqada iimaylka la hawlgeliyo si uu u shaqeeyo.
multimail-manager-primary-email-not-conf: Cinwaanka iimaylka aasaasiga ah waa in la xaqiijiyaa ka hor inta aan la beddelin.
multimail-manager-secondary-email-not-co: Cinwaanka iimaylka labaad waa in la xaqiijiyaa ka hor inta aan laga dhigin cinwaanka iimaylka aasaasiga ah.
multimail-primary-swapped_subject: Beddelidda cinwaanka iimaylka aasaasiga ah ee {{SITENAME}}
multimail-primary-swapped_body:
Salaan $1,

Tani waa farriin si otomaatig ah loo soo diray oo ku ogeysiinaysa in cinwaankaaga iimaylka aasaasiga ah ee {{SITENAME}} laga beddelay $2 loona beddelay $3 $4, iyadoo laga isticmaalay cinwaanka IP-ga $5. Haddii aadan adigu samayn, waxaad ka noqon kartaa isbeddelkan adigoo booqanaya $6.
multimail-confirmationmail-secondary_bod:
Qof, oo ay u badan tahay inaad adigu tahay, kana socda cinwaanka IP-ga $1,
ayaa cinwaankan iimaylka ku daray akoonka "$2" ee {{SITENAME}}.

Si aad u xaqiijiso in akoonkani dhab ahaan adiga kuu yahay, ku fur xidhiidhkan biraawsarkaaga:

$3

Haddii akoonku aanu adiga kuu ahayn, waad iska indho tiri kartaa iimaylkan.

Koodhkan xaqiijintu wuxuu dhacayaa $4.

multimail-manager-db-add-new-secondary-f: Fashilantay in cinwaanka cusub ee iimaylka lagu kaydiyo kaydka xogta.
multimail-emails-invalid-id: Cinwaan iimayl oo aan sax ahayn
multimail-emails-invalid-id-body: Cinwaanka iimaylka la doortay ma aha cinwaan iimayl oo sax ah.
multimail-manager-no-such-email-in-db: Cinwaankan iimaylka lagama helin kaydka xogta.
multimail-js-reauthentication-required: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad xaqiijiso aqoonsigaaga. Gujinta "$1" waxay ku geyn doontaa foomka gelitaanka. Kadib xaqiijinta, waxaa dib laguugu soo celin doonaa halkan.
